what_changed: Light canvas; grey rounded box top with 'Q. Supposing you did drain earth's oceans and dumped the water on top of the Curiosity rover, how would Mars change as the water accumulated?' and '- Iain'; black-ink stick figure left holding a white paper; large empty black-outlined rectangle right. No comment cards.

White YouTube-style comment cards (avatar, handle, tiny text, like icons) pop on one at a time across 1.54-2.04s at left, lower-right, top and middle, partly covering the Q box; text mostly unreadable at tile scale (e.g. 'But what would happen on Mars (and how long before the Dutch take over)').
Q box, figure, and about five comment cards (left, lower-left, lower-right, top-left, one overlapping the Q box).
Many more comment cards appear within 5 frames, piling and overlapping across the whole canvas, hiding Q box and figure; text unreadable at tile scale.
Dense overlapping pile of comment cards covers the whole frame.

Comment pile replaced by Q box, stick figure with paper, and black panel containing grey Earth (upper) and small brown Mars (lower). First activity frame still shows pile with black panel patches showing through; clearing mechanism between frames unclear.
Q box top, stick figure left holding paper, black panel right with grey Earth upper-middle and brown Mars lower-middle, tiny white stars.
